verdict.rationale: Capacities documents one built-in recurring job: automated full exports configured via 'Add Schedule'. That is a genuine recurring schedule, but it is limited to exports. Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined scheduled workflows, scheduled AI or agent runs, or cron-style triggers; the AI assistant's multi-step planning is interactive and approval-based, not scheduled. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, scheduled AI or agent tasks, schedule management or trigger documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can schedule automatic exports by going to `Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule`.
